review_description: Found the supplier on Facebook and traced a few goodle reviews.Received a quote within 2 days of initial contact with required details such as electrical supply, roof layout, floorplan and current electricity usage.Installation proceeded within 2 weeks of accepting quote and deposit of $99.I opted for a higher spec system instead of what was advertised on Facebook and paid a total of $3799.Solar Panel: 14 x Tier-1 JINKO 475W Tiger Neo N-type Mono-facial Half-Cut Cell Technology Black Frame Panels (25-year product warranty & 30-year performance warranty)Solar Inverter: 1 x 5kVA SUNGROW SG5K-D Single Phase Inverter (10-year warranty)Monitoring: Sungrow WiFi Monitoring SystemSungrow CT MeterContact person was Dave and he was very professional and responsive.Installers came on time and kept the place clean and tidy. Only broke 1 roof tile which they replaced with our spare.Installation was completed within about 3 hours.It's been 1 month now and so far so good.
